'''Vander''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
General Vander was Republic chief of operations for Ord Mantell, commanding all its military forces during the [[Separatist War]]. He promoted a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|Commando]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the famous [[Havoc Squad]] to the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] for disabling the stolen [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb|ZR-57]]. He tasked the newly-promoted lieutenant with rebuilding the [[Havoc Squad|squad]] after defection of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harron Tavus]] and his men to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He also assigned recently-demoted [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Aric Jorgan]] as Havoc's first new member, claiming that was all he could do for the soldier whose career had been tainted by the betrayal of his comrades. Later, he contacted Jorgan, offering him to return to his previous post at [[Ord Mantell Infantry Command]], but the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] refused politely, stating that his goal for a while was to capture and punish Tavus.

During the [[Galactic War]], just before the beginning of the [[Revanite crisis]], General Vander was in command of a Republic liberation force sent to the planet [[Altair 9]]. Following a ten-month long siege, his forces, aided by a [[Eclipse Squad|Special Forces unit]]<ref name="TOR Eclipse">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Trooper|Eclipse Squad|Rishi}}</ref>, which infiltrated the city and disabled the Imperial defensive network, captured the capital of [[Klemark]]. All Imperial defenders were either killed or captured and food as well as other aid was subsequently provided to the long-suffering populace. Vander would speak to a small collection of journalists in the hours following this victory, saying "Truly, this is a stunning victory that all Republic citizens can feel proud of!"<ref name="Mail Altair">{{TORcite|type=message|FWD: Republic Victory on Altair 9|M1-4X}}</ref>
